label: GO after a rewarded trial, strongly committed to a2, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at the GO step (never D1/D2), only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1 at D1), only when the policy strongly favours a2 (choice logit < -8; model_act=a2 on 100% of activations; a1 choices essentially never), and almost only in late episode (ep_trial >= ~60, peaking at 80-99; value is low there too). The predicate captures ~94% of activation mass but precision is ~0.36: many late rewarded a2 GO steps are silent. Magnitude is largest on the first rewarded trial after an unrewarded one (r0 then r1 a2 -> ~1.0 of max), and decays over consecutive rewarded a2 trials (0.35, 0.13, ...); adding tv(prev_reward,-1)!=1 raises precision to 0.48 but lowers recall to 0.64. Does not fire after unrewarded trials, on a1 choices, or early in episodes. All variables observed (choice is the agent own policy at GO).
